durability_alarm.slot.head: Helmet
durability_alarm.settings.title: Durability Alarm
durability_alarm.settings.subtitle: Warnings before your equipment breaks
durability_alarm.settings.hint.enabled: Enable or disable warnings. The preview works independently of this setting.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.scope: All carried items: inventory, hotbar, equipment, off hand and cursor. Equipped items: main hand and equipped slots. Chest, shulker box and bundle contents and custom accessory slots are not inspected.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.warning: Warn when the remaining durability is at or below this percentage. Uses exact values, not rounded percentages.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.critical: Red warning and higher-pitched sound. The final durability point always triggers a critical warning.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.sound: Local sound on a new warning. Other players cannot hear it. Also affected by the game's master volume.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.volume: Alert volume. Minecraft's master volume also affects it.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.chat: Also display a message in your local chat. It is never sent to the server.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.creative: Disabled in creative mode by default. Spectators never receive warnings.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.position: Choose a corner to avoid overlapping minimaps or other HUD mods.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.repeat: Remind only if durability has decreased since the previous sound. Idle spare items never repeat. Disabling reminders does not disable new critical threshold alerts.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.rows: Extra items rotate every 5 seconds. With at least two rows, the most damaged item stays pinned in the first row.
durability_alarm.settings.hint.test: Show an 8-second preview. Does not give items or damage any of your equipment.
durability_alarm.settings.save_error: Durability Alarm: could not save settings. They apply until the game closes; see latest.log.
